residents.greet: Welcome to the Riverwood Trader! My sister Camilla and I stock a little bit of everything for travelers on the White River road.
residents.talk: Between the loggers at Gerdur's mill and pilgrims heading toward Whiterun, our shelves stay busy year-round.
residents.secret: Thieves broke into the shop at night and stole my prized golden claw—they headed straight up the mountain toward Bleak Falls Barrow.

residents.name: Alvor
residents.title: Blacksmith of Riverwood
residents.bark: Good steel and honest iron—step up to the anvil if you need your gear mended.
residents.greet: Need a blade sharpened or a horseshoe fitted? Step under the forge roof before the mountain rain starts.
residents.talk: White River water cools our steel clean and hard, just as my father taught me at this anvil.
residents.secret: After what happened at Helgen, every family in Riverwood has been watching the southern mountain pass.

residents.name: Camilla Valerius
residents.title: Shopkeeper
residents.bark: It's a bright day along the White River, if Lucan stops fretting over that stolen claw.
residents.greet: Welcome to Riverwood! If you're looking to buy or sell, speak with my brother Lucan at the counter.
residents.talk: Sven and Faendal both think they're being clever vying for my attention, though Riverwood is small enough that everyone knows.
residents.secret: If anyone recovers our golden claw from Bleak Falls Barrow, I'll gladly show them the bridge toward the barrow path myself.

residents.name: Delphine
residents.title: Proprietor of the Sleeping Giant Inn
residents.bark: Keep the hearth swept, Orgnar—travelers from the pass will want a dry room tonight.
residents.greet: Welcome to the Sleeping Giant Inn. Rent a room if you're staying, or talk to Orgnar at the bar for food and drink.
residents.talk: I keep the inn quiet and mind my own business. Folks passing between Falkreath and Whiterun appreciate a place that doesn't pry.
residents.secret: Reports from Helgen say a dragon razed the keep—something ancient is waking along the mountain ridges.

residents.name: Gerdur
residents.title: Mill Owner
residents.bark: As long as the White River runs, our sawblade turns pine into beams for all of Whiterun Hold.
residents.greet: Careful near the saw-race! My husband Hod and I run the Riverwood Lumber Mill.
residents.talk: Every timber beam in Whiterun's roofs came down the river from our mill here in the valley.
residents.secret: Without walls or a garrison of our own, Riverwood will need Jarl Balgruuf to send guards if dragons or bandits come down from the pass.

residents.name: Hod
residents.title: Sawyer
residents.bark: Another log on the carriage—keep the waterwheel clear of drift-bark.
residents.greet: If you've got strong arms and don't mind sawdust, there's always wood to split at the mill.
residents.talk: Gerdur handles the tallies and I keep the logs moving. A man doesn't need more than pine, river-water, and a warm hearth.
residents.secret: Stormcloaks and Imperials can fight over thrones all they want, so long as they pay coin for their siege timber.

residents.name: Faendal
residents.title: Archery Trainer & Millhand
residents.bark: Deer tracks stay fresh in the pine needles above the gorge if you know how to read the wind.
residents.greet: Watch your step in the woods above Riverwood—wolves and bandits prowl the trail toward Bleak Falls.
residents.talk: I work at Gerdur's mill by day and hunt the pine slopes at dusk. If you want to steady your bow-hand, I can teach you.
residents.secret: Sven thinks a few tavern verses will win Camilla Valerius over, though he barely leaves his mother's hearth.

residents.name: Ralof
residents.title: Son of Riverwood
residents.bark: It's good to see the pines of Riverwood standing tall above the White River.
residents.greet: Walking back across the Riverwood bridge after Helgen feels like waking from a nightmare.
residents.talk: My sister Gerdur and her husband Hod keep the mill running. Growing up here, we never imagined dragons returning in our lifetime.
residents.secret: All of Skyrim is on a knife's edge—Whiterun won't be able to stay out of the war forever.

residents.talk: Timber-rafters from Gerdur's mill and hunters coming down from Bleak Falls keep my taps busy.
residents.secret: Lucan Valerius across the street at the Riverwood Trader had his golden claw stolen by bandits up on the mountain.

residents.name: Sven
residents.title: Minstrel of the Sleeping Giant
residents.bark: A song by the hearth warms the evening faster than a mug of Nord mead.
residents.greet: Pull up a bench by the fire! I play the lute here at the Sleeping Giant Inn every evening.
residents.talk: Between working the mill logs and playing requests for travelers, life in Riverwood is peaceful—until my mother Hilde starts talking about dragons.
residents.secret: That elf Faendal keeps hanging around the Riverwood Trader trying to impress Camilla Valerius.

residents.title: Blacksmith's Wife

residents.secret: I pray to Kyne every night that the troubles in the mountain pass pass right over our valley.
